name: wing_flex_script_invents_passenger_comfort
provenance: Golden E2E #9 showed passenger/cabin comfort appearing downstream of an aircraft-wing-flex Candidate. This fixture blocks that invented benefit at ScriptPlan time.

candidate.observable_phenomenon: visible upward elastic bending during flight
candidate.core_question: why does the wing flex upward under load
candidate.mechanism: aerodynamic lift load causes elastic bending and load redistribution
candidate.reveal: the wing carries load by elastically deforming rather than acting as a rigid plate
visual_proof: main wing visibly bends upward under aerodynamic load
